title: Book Three · Chapter 157: The High Ball
story:
On Saturday, Kai finds Ronan near the park field.

“Too much paper,” he says. “Come and miss a goal.”

Ronan closes his school book and puts it in his bag. Anna and Lin are walking back from their run. They stop to watch the first few passes.

Kai has his own ball today. He sends it high, and Ronan steps back to meet it.

It goes over his head.

Anna laughs. “Very high paper.”

“No page number,” Ronan says.

He fetches it and sends it back lower. Kai stops it, then shows him where to put his foot for the next kick.

They try a few times. The ball stays closer to the grass now. Ronan turns his foot a little, and the next pass reaches Kai.

Lin wants a turn. She gives Anna her jacket and takes Kai's place. Her first pass runs along the ground, straight toward Ronan.

“A very sensible ball,” he says.

Lin smiles. Then her second kick goes far to the side.

“It changed its mind.”

Ronan runs after it. By the time he returns, Anna has put the jackets on the bench and joined them.

They play a short game with bags for goals. Kai and Lin take one side. Anna and Ronan take the other.

Anna runs fast enough to reach a loose pass. She stops it badly, then taps it toward Ronan before Kai can get there.

He sends it through the little goal.

“A good pair,” he says.

“For that one,” she answers, smiling.

The next ball catches his shoe and goes the wrong way. Kai takes it and scores at the other end.

At last, they stop beside the bench. Lin opens her water bottle. Anna stretches her arms above her head, then sits near Ronan.

For a while, nobody talks about lessons or next year's plans. Kai tells them about his cousin's very loud little dog.

“Smaller than this,” he says, with his hands around the ball.

“More noise than you?” Lin asks.

“Nearly.”

They laugh. Ronan leans back on his hands and looks at the pale winter sky.

When Lin and Kai leave, Anna stays beside him for a few minutes. She takes his cold hand between both of hers.

“Still thinking about the high ball?”

“A little.”

She smiles and moves her shoulder against his. He sits closer, and they watch the next group of players put their bags beside the field.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sensible＝稳妥的、合乎常理的；tap＝轻轻碰、轻踢；stretch＝伸展；pale＝浅淡的。

## 理解问题

1. 本章用的是谁的球？Ronan和Anna各有怎样实际但不完美的表现？
2. 四人这段休闲是否一直在谈未来费用？哪些细节表现情侣的普通亲近？

## 读句子

**She takes his cold hand between both of hers.**

拆开看：She / takes his cold hand / between both of hers.

她／握住他冰凉的手／夹在自己的双手之间。
